title: UK fintech funding hits lowest level in a decade
summary: UK fintech funding dropped to its lowest level in a decade in the first half of 2026, with firms receiving just £1.8 billion in investment, according to the latest KPMG figures.
content: UK fintech funding has dropped to its lowest level in a decade during the first half of 2026. According to figures released by KPMG, firms across the country received a total of just 1.8 billion pounds in investment during this period. This sharp decline highlights a significant slowdown in financial technology investment within the region compared to previous years.
